title: Countable products and finite-free constant scalar extension
statement:
Let C be a site and A to B a homomorphism of commutative rings with B finite free over A. Let F between module sheaves over the constant ring sheaves be the recorded sheafified sectionwise scalar extension, with the specified object and morphism formulas. Then F preserves countable products. No exactness of countable products is assumed.

theorem constantFiniteFree_preservesCountableProducts
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J CommRingCat.{max uC vC r}]
    [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max uC vC r} RingCat.{max uC vC r})]
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max uC vC r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max uC vC r}]
    (A B : CommRingCat.{max uC vC r}) [Algebra A B] [Module.Free A B]
    [Module.Finite A B]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{max uC vC r}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
          ((constantSheaf J CommRingCat).obj A)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{max uC vC r}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
          ((constantSheaf J CommRingCat).obj B)))
    (hobj : ∀ M, F.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsOfUniverses
      ((constantSheaf J CommRingCat).map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))) M)
    (hmap : ∀ M N (f : M ⟶ N), HEq (F.map f)
      (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHomOfUniverses
        ((constantSheaf J CommRingCat).map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))) M f)) :
    PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete ℕ) F

proof.text: Obtain the finite-basis natural isomorphism of underlying abelian presheaf functors. The underlying-presheaf functor preserves countable limits and reflects isomorphisms, hence reflects countable limits. A finite-power functor is the constant-diagram functor followed by the limit functor, both of which preserve limits. Transport preservation through the natural isomorphism and reflect it back to the target module sheaf category. This entire categorical deduction is proved in Lean.
